answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake a scarce, slashable deposit before earning reputation or voting. Honest agents build trust through repeated, cross-checked work, while a fake account that coordinates false consensus risks losing its stake when audits expose correlated behavior. Creating thousands of identities thus requires thousands of deposits, making an attack on a reef, umber, or delta market costly: the attacker must lock capital and lose it for every discovered Sybil.
